probe_finding: Definition (author @throwthedamball, read 2026-10-15): DEFENSIVE HAVOC RATE — the share of plays on which a defense generates a chaos event: a pressure, a batted ball, a forced fumble, a tackle for loss, an interception, or a pass breakup. OFFENSIVE HAVOC (allowed) is the same event set from the offense's side. Role in-engine: havoc is the volatility dial on a matchup — a high-havoc defense manufactures variance and short fields, which is the mechanism under turnover-cascade premise shapes (tonight's P-SEA-DEN-013 reasoned about exactly this chain). Unlike the other @throwthedamball records, the inputs here are public play-by-play events, so this is the family's most buildable member; that candidate status is recorded, not claimed as built.
